table.retrieve:
SELECT	dbo.adjBufferHeader.adjbuffercode,  
			dbo.adjBufferheader.date, 
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.posted,
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.Usercode,
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.Remarks,
			dbo.users.username,
			aliasname = dbo.item.customicode,
			itemname = dbo.item.name,
			dbo.adjbufferdetail.stockinhand,
			dbo.adjbufferdetail.stockonshelf,
			godown=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=adjbufferheader.gcode),
			itemclass=(select name from itemclass where itemclass.iccode=item.iccode),
			ReOrderQty=item.ReOrderQty,
			SalePrice=Item.SalePrice/(CASE item.packunits when 0 then 1 else Item.packunits end),
			manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
			difference=adjbufferdetail.stockinhand -  adjbufferdetail.stockonshelf

FROM  dbo.adjbufferHeader,
		 dbo.adjbufferDetail,
		 dbo.users, 
		 dbo.item

WHERE 	dbo.adjBufferHeader.adjbuffercode = :ai_adjcode and 
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.adjbuffercode = adjBufferDetail.adjbuffercode and 
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.usercode = dbo.users.usercode and
			dbo.adjBufferDetail.icode = dbo.item.icode

ORDER BY itemclass,
			 itemname
